newsitem.title: USA: Contested Con Edison testimony allowed.
newsitem.headline: Contested Con Edison testimony allowed.

text.p: The New York State Department of Public Service said an administrative law judge ruled Wednesday that almost all the testimony in the Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc restructurting settlement should be allowed.
The department said there were motions to strike testimony of 24 different witnesses in the case.

Most of them were made by Con Edison and/or the department staff based on the claim the testimony was generic -- not specific to this case -- or related to things falling under federal regulation, a utility spokesman said.

As part of a procedural ruling, Judge Judith A. Lee determined all of the testimony shoudl be admitted except for a page of testimony from one witness, testimony from two others and exhibits from a fourth.
